question.text: For isothermal expansion of an ideal gas, the correct combination of the thermodynamic parameters will be

solution.text:
For isothermal expansion of an ideal gas
$$
\Delta T=0
$$
$\therefore$ From $\Delta U=n C_{v} \Delta T$
$$
\begin{array}{l}
\Delta U=0 \text { and, from } \\
\Delta H=n C_{\rho} \Delta t=0
\end{array}
$$
From first law of thermodynamics,
$$
\Delta U=Q+W
$$
as
$$
\Delta U=0 \Rightarrow Q \neq 0
$$
and
$$
W \neq 0
$$
$\therefore$ Parameters are
$$
\Delta U=0, Q \neq 0 ; W \neq 0
$$
and $\Delta H=0$
